answer: Sequential Ritual Anchoring. Each identity must anchor itself to a publicly verifiable physical event (a timed sensor reading at a known inlet) and then complete a randomized multi-day lotus-growing task whose progress is logged by independent witnesses; registration keys derive from the full chain. Attacker cost: real physical presence, days of sustained labor, and colluding witnesses who each forfeit their own standing if the record is disproven. Mass fabrication becomes logistically infeasible, not merely expensive.
